title: NASA employee wrote a CIA remote viewing training manual
summary: Kevin Knuth tells of NASA employee wrote a CIA remote viewing training manual, about before the 2000s at NASA / CIA, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: one of the people at NASA wrote a CIA training manual for remote viewing.

plain: Kevin Knuth, a scientist who once worked at NASA, the US space agency, says he was told that one of his NASA colleagues wrote a training manual for the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency. The manual, he says, was for remote viewing: the claimed skill of seeing distant places or hidden things with the mind alone. If true, it would tie a government science agency to psychic spying work.
